meta.source: Independent pandas, zoneinfo and chrono admission observations; producer and timezone versions are recorded below.
meta.reference_tzdata_note: the expectations were taken over this version; tzdata-2026c/ holds its files for the corpus zones, copied from macOS 26.7.1 /usr/share/zoneinfo, the database the reference read

probe_sources.note: SHA-256 hashes of the independent fixture-producing probe sources.

kinds.zone_from_utc: local wall time and UTC offset of a UTC instant (tz_convert); gating
kinds.zone_to_utc: the UTC instant of a wall time, or a refusal for a gap or fold (tz_localize defaults); gating
kinds.offset: base plus, minus and three times a DateOffset; gating
kinds.unit: nanoseconds to seconds, wire text and back; compared with the chrono answer
kinds.unit_ms: milliseconds to a timestamp; compared with the chrono answer
kinds.parse_value: one value of an accepted shape read as a UTC instant; compared with the chrono answer
kinds.pql_literal: a PQL date literal under rules D1 to D9 without D8; compared with the chrono answer

selection.rule: Both UTC directions, every zone: Jan15/Jul1 at12:00 in1970/2038/2200; all recorded gap/fold refusals. Expected values copied unchanged from independently produced original.
